scope: Two-phase pre-generation and post-generation commitment controls for future live anchor-review queue generation.
adversarial_cases: secret seed material rejected even after record digest recomputation
reviewer email field rejected even after record digest recomputation
missing reviewer queue rejected after all dependent digests were recomputed
claim_limit: Focused engineering validation only. No live seed, queue, protected mapping, reviewer identity, expert judgment, trusted timestamp, anchor validation, or construct validation was created or established.
ci_observability_blocker: GitHub combined-status returned no statuses and the available workflow-run connector exposes only pull-request-triggered runs; absence of status is not treated as a workflow pass or failure.
